study.description: Among high-confidence Stage-1 flip predictions (frozen Model C, TRAIN P90), does information available at the decision timestamp T distinguish economically clean reversals (CLEAN_TRADABLE_REVERSAL, target T1) from ugly, weak, or failed ones. Schema/contract expressibility proof for the composite-target, derived-causal-input, and required-gate closures documented in RESEARCH_WORKFLOW.md §20 -- see research_decision.yaml for the full decision contract. criteria.R1: Stage-1 score alone substantially ranks clean-path probability
criteria.R4: classification signal exists but forward economic enrichment is weak
